## Où j'en suis
Real SAML login with Fernhill’s IdP works on staging. JIT provisioning from merged PR #415 creates users with the `viewer` role; PR #421 is open with short RelayState storage and per-tenant group-to-role mapping. The full test suite passed (1,301 passed, 3 skipped). The Fernhill groups claim is still pending, ahead of the Thursday, Nov 19, 10:00 ET demo. (source: ses-sso-3, kestrel-analytics/platform#415, kestrel-analytics/platform#421, src-linear-kes311)

- [en-cours] PR #421 is open; group mapping cannot be validated until Fernhill adds the `groups` claim. (source: ses-sso-3, kestrel-analytics/platform#421)
- [prochaine-étape] Get Fernhill IT to add the groups claim; then verify the admin mapping and prepare an admin test account for the demo. (source: ses-sso-3, src-linear-kes311)
- [décision] Keep `viewer` as the default role and leave SP-initiated login enabled; do not adopt the Slack request for `analyst` by default or IdP-initiated-only login. (source: s3-07)
